about_the_game:
This demo version includes a single trial map and unlocks some buildings and units.


The Playable Demo of Era of Survival is Now Available – Come and Try It Out!

QQ Group for Player Communication: 590941124

As the game is still in the early stage of development, there are still many incomplete design aspects and program bugs. We welcome you to provide feedback in the discussion section. I will continue to update this playable demo and strive to improve the experience of the full version.

Thank you again for your feedback and suggestions!

Era of Survival (Playable Demo) is a casual-oriented turn-based strategic survival game. No complex operations are required – simply match buildings and form teams with ease to get a preview of the casual strategic fun of "placing buildings, automatic troop deployment, and commanding with commanders".

short_description: Era of Survival is a turn-based strategy survival game blending resource management and 攻防 (offensive-defensive) gameplay. As a frontier settler, you’ll build a wilderness stronghold and fend off 30 waves of relentless enemies, proving your strategic skill through shrewd tactics.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
